feeds.title: Project Cece Blog
feeds.description: Stay up to date on the latest stories to do with sustainable and ethical fashion. Here you can find our knowledge base and updates. At Project Cece you can choose from 5 sustainability filters: environmentally friendly, fair trade, vegan, locally produced, and good cause. By filtering on sustainability labels, you only shop the products that fit your values. It is also possible to filter on certificates and materials.

feeds.title: Curiously Conscious
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Besma. Curiously Conscious is my journal where I document kinder ways to live and dress. I like to cover sustainable fashion, cruelty-free beauty, low-impact living, and more. I want every item I own to tell a good story, and to retell them to you here on the blog.

feeds.title: Centre for Sustainable Fashion Blog
feeds.description: We are the Centre for Sustainable Fashion (CSF), a University of the Arts London research, education, and knowledge exchange center. Our work explores vital elements of Better Lives London College of Fashion's commitment to using fashion to drive change, build a sustainable future, and improve the way we live. CSF was devised to question and challenge reactionary fashion cultures, which reflect and re-enforce patterns of excessive consumption and disconnection, to expand fashion's ability to connect, delight, and identify individual and collective values.

feeds.title: Roberta Style Lee Blog
feeds.description: Sustainable personal style, lifestyle & shopping tips, ethical & sustainable brand reviews blog by London's Sustainable Style expert Roberta Lee. Roberta has been a passionate advocate for sustainable style since 2015. Roberta Style Lee is about inspiring confidence and empowering women to be the best version of themselves.

feeds.title: Literally Nataly
feeds.description: Literally Nataly is a Sustainable fashion, ethical luxury, and lifestyle blog by Nataly Elbaz Björklund. It's mission is Creating awareness on sustainability issues and introducing ethical, sustainable, eco-friendly, slow fashion & lifestyle brands.

feeds.title: The Fair Edit
feeds.description: I'm Beatrice and I created The Fair Edit from a mutual love of lifestyle, and of life. Combining my devotion to ethical and sustainable practices with fashion and style. Seeking out fashion that supports sustainability and fair trade, philanthropy, green travel and cruelty-free beauty, The Fair Edit is a paragon of meaningful lifestyle tips.

feeds.title: Ruth MacGilp Blog
feeds.description: Explore the latest blog posts from ethical fashion fashion writer Ruth MacGilp. Discover ethical fashion brands and designers, learn about the problems in the fast fashion industry and find out how to get involved in the sustainable fashion revolution. I'm Ruth MacGilp. I collaborate with purpose-driven brands, publications and non-profits to develop engaging content and campaigns about the intersection of fashion and sustainability.

feeds.title: Where Does it Come From » Sustainability Hints and Tips
feeds.description: Where Does It Come From? is an award-winning social enterprise that creates clothing and textiles that are kind - to our planet, to garment makers and to you too. What's more, everything we make is fully traceable using a code printed on the label, so you can discover exactly how and where yours were made, all the way back to the cotton growing in the field. Check out our tips and hints on sustainability in clothing and fashion industry, brands and more!

feeds.title: Boy Wonder » Sustainable Fashion
feeds.description: Our blog posts cover subjects such as kids activities, ethical & sustainable fashion and green issues. Boy Wonder is designed for parents who value creative, unique style for their kids. We believe boys should have as much fun with fashion as girls!

feeds.title: Moral Fibres » Ethical Fashion
feeds.description: I'm Wendy and welcome to Moral Fibres, a UK-based eco-blog. I'm a sustainability expert, and my aim is to make sustainability simple, by researching and writing on all things environmental - from product guides to breaking down big ideas - so you don't have to. Check out my articles on ethical fashion to know more about the eco-friendly fashion advice, options, sustainable fashion brands and more!

feeds.title: RetroSpecced » Sustainable Fashion
feeds.description: Retrospecced recycles and refurbishes fabulous vintage, antique and designer frames for sustainable fashion! Follow us to keep up with articles on Sustainable Fashion.

feeds.title: Style and Sustain
feeds.description: A place to inspire fashion lovers like myself to turn to sustainable fashion: photos, brands and tips that will transform your wardrobe and preserve the planet. I'm Amma. A writer, podcaster and digital content creator passionate about sustainable and ethical fashion.
